about: The offertorium “Ascéndit Deus” (Psalm 46:6) in the 1962 Roman Missal. It belongs to the Mass of the Ascension of the Lord, which the Missal also appoints for the weekdays from the Friday after the Ascension to the Friday before the Vigil of Pentecost. The Mass of the Sunday after the Ascension repeats it in full.

seg.tr: God has ascended with jubilation, and the Lord with the sound of the trumpet, alleluia.
